metaTitle: How to Use and Adjust Trekking Poles
description: Set trekking pole length to a 90 degree elbow, use the wrist strap, and adjust for climbs, descents and stream crossings, plus locks and materials.
directAnswer: Set poles so your elbow bends about 90 degrees on flat ground, shorten them for climbs and lengthen for descents, and let the wrist strap carry load so you can keep a light grip.
